name: XCC_CF_TRANSACTION_ERRORS
description: This table contains any errors encountered by the carry forward enterprise service scheduler process while final closing and reopening purchase orders. The Carry Forward Results Report uses this data to show the results of the carry forward enterprise service scheduler process. Data in this table is purged at a later time by the archive and purge process.

columns.name: PO_LINE_ID
columns.description: Purchase order document line unique identifier if the error is specific to a line. References PO_LINES_ALL.PO_LINE_ID.

columns.name: PO_LINE_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Purchase order shipment schedule unique identifier if the error is specific to a schedule. References PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.LINE_LOCATION_ID.

columns.name: PO_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Purchase order document distribution unique identifier if the error is specific to a distribution. References PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.DISTRIBUTION_ID.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Carry forward transaction action error sequence for display purpose.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
